headline: Rain Dampens Sox Momentum In The Bronx While Football Rumors Heat Up
morning_brew: Mother Nature decided to play spoiler in the Bronx on Saturday night. The matchup between the Sox and the Yankees got postponed, which is absolutely brutal timing for a club that finally built up some positive momentum. We were riding a nice three-game road winning streak after Friday night's win, and now everything gets put on ice. It is always frustrating to lose a game to the weather, especially when you are trying to climb out of a twenty-seven and thirty-five hole in the AL East. Now we just have to wait for the next opportunity to get back on the dirt and keep pushing.

Over in Foxborough, there is plenty of chatter about our new weapon on the outside. People are already drawing comparisons between A.J. Brown and Randy Moss when he arrived in New England nearly twenty years ago. That is some incredibly heavy praise, but the motivation seems to be exactly the same. Brown is looking to prove a point after leaving Philadelphia, and having a guy with that kind of chip on his shoulder is exactly what Drake Maye needs. If he can bring even a fraction of that classic Moss dominance to this offense, this team is going to be incredibly fun to watch in the fall.

Meanwhile, the offseason is officially underway for the winter teams, and the rumors are already flying. After the Bruins got bounced in the first round by Buffalo, general manager Sweeney has to be looking at every possible avenue to upgrade this roster. Some intriguing trade candidates are starting to pop up on the market, and the front office cannot afford to stand pat after a disappointing exit. We need to see some real aggression this summer because the fans in this town are not going to tolerate another year of early exits. The standard is always championships in the Hub, and it is time to start building back toward that level.

trend_watch.trend: Blasting home runs and carrying the middle of the order during the recent road trip.
trend_watch.dans_take: He has been an absolute force at the plate, and we need him to keep this up if we are going to climb back into the race.

trend_watch.trend: Gearing up for his sophomore season with major new targets on the outside.
trend_watch.dans_take: Getting A.J. Brown is a massive win for the kid's development, and I cannot wait to see them connect in training camp.

trend_watch.trend: Facing a long offseason of speculation after an early exit against Buffalo.
trend_watch.dans_take: He is still the guy in net for us, but the front office has to build a better defense in front of him this summer.

news_digest.headline: Similar motivations for A.J. Brown now and Randy Moss then
news_digest.dans_take: If Brown can channel even half of that 2007 Moss energy, our offense is going to be absolutely electric.

news_digest.dans_take: Playing in the Bronx is always a battle, but we have to keep this road streak alive once the weather clears.
